lines.text: ペンギンが小石を贈るって知ってた？
prompts: a cute gentoo penguin standing on a rocky shore holding a small pebble in its beak, storybook illustration
a penguin colony on a snowy coast under soft light, storybook illustration

lines.text: ジェンツーペンギンのオスは、石を探し歩く。
prompts: a gentoo penguin walking along a pebble beach searching the ground, storybook illustration
close view of smooth round pebbles of many colors on a beach, storybook illustration

lines.text: 選ぶのは、できるだけ滑らかできれいな石なんだ。
prompts: a penguin carefully picking up a smooth shiny pebble, storybook illustration
a small pile of smooth pretty stones in soft sunlight

lines.text: それをくちばしでくわえて、気になる相手の前へ。
prompts: a penguin carrying a pebble across the snow toward another penguin, storybook illustration
two penguins facing each other on a rocky shore, storybook illustration

lines.text: 石をそっと置く姿は、まるで贈り物のようだね。
prompts: a penguin gently placing a pebble at the feet of another penguin, storybook illustration
a pebble resting on the ground between two penguins at sunset

lines.text: 石は巣作りにも使われるから、大切な宝物なんだ。
prompts: a penguin nest made of many small stones with an egg in it, storybook illustration
a penguin sitting on a stone nest on a hillside, storybook illustration

lines.text: フォローして、次の雑学も受け取ってね！
prompts: a happy penguin waving a flipper at sunset over a calm icy sea, storybook illustration
